/about.title: Neha Yadav Design Portfolio
/about.description: I’m Neha Yadav, a Product Designer experienced in XR, games, and interactive platforms, creating user-centered solutions that scale across digital products.
p: I grew up watching shows like M.A.D and Art Attack which first sparked my love for making things, whether a birthday card or a cardboard castle.

With a background in Computer Applications, I found my way into product design during the pandemic, where creativity and problem-solving finally clicked together. Today, I design thoughtful, immersive experiences that balance imagination with structure.
At home, life revolves around Leo my little ginger cat who makes sure my gallery stays 90% cat content.
The rest is filled with the paws I meet on the streets or during visits to a local cat shelter that cares for 150+ rescues.
It’s my happy place outside of design, & if you ever feel like sharing some love, the shelter is always grateful for a helping hand.
